scripts.check:api: find js/api api -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node tests/api-runtime.test.mjs && node tests/blob-upload.test.mjs
scripts.check:all: npm run check:syntax && npm run audit:dead-code && npm run audit:exports && npm run check:api && npm run check:ai
scripts.check:syntax: find js api server tests -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.test:all: set -e; for test in tests/*.test.mjs; do echo "=== $test ==="; node "$test"; done
scripts.verify: npm run check:all && npm run test:all
